headline: Bitcoin recovers following AI-led selloff ahead of US jobs data
summary: Bitcoin rebounded from approximately $75,200 following a Thursday AI-driven selloff that caused over $1 billion in liquidations, while traders await the upcoming U.S. jobs report.
why: Cryptocurrency markets are increasingly sensitive to broader macroeconomic data releases, such as U.S. employment figures, which influence Federal Reserve interest rate expectations and risk sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after a prior selloff.
